source.name: Twins Daily: Twins Join the Jersey Patch Era with Securian Financial Sponsorship
source.quote: the team announced a new multi-year partnership with Securian Financial, which includes the addition of a jersey patch featuring the St. Paul-based financial services firm

note: Jersey patch. The patch debuted after the 2025 All-Star break; Sports Business Journal reported the deal on 2025-07-17 (https://www.sportsbusinessjournal.com/Articles/2025/07/17/securian-financial-becomes-twins-first-ever-jersey-patch-sponsor, paywalled, not opened by script).
